description: Only results classified after 12th (13th onward) are included. Results classified exactly 12th are excluded.

b.request: For each race, calculate the average number of laps completed by drivers finishing in positions 13th or lower (positionOrder > 12), grouped by race ID and race name, ordered by average laps descending with races lacking a calculable average placed last, showing the top 10 races by average laps.
b.sql: SELECT r.raceId, ra.name, AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) as average_laps FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE r.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, ra.name ORDER BY average_laps IS NULL, average_laps DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: For each race, calculate the average number of laps completed by drivers finishing in positions 13th or lower (positionOrder > 12), grouped by race ID and race name, ordered by average laps descending with races lacking a calculable average placed last, showing the top 10 races by average laps.

a.request: Considering only race results whose classification order (`positionOrder`) is greater than 12, each matched to its race, show for each race (grouped by race ID and race name) the race ID, the race name, and the average number of laps completed (`laps`, ignoring missing values). List the 10 races with the highest average first, with any race lacking an average placed last.
a.sql: SELECT races.raceId, races.name, AVG(CAST(r.laps AS FLOAT)) as avg_laps FROM results r JOIN races ON r.raceId = races.raceId WHERE r.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY races.raceId, races.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10;

c.request: Looking only at back-of-the-field results, using 12 as the cutoff on classification order (`positionOrder`), and matching each result to its race: for each race (grouped by race ID and race name), show the race ID, the race name, and the average number of laps completed (`laps`, ignoring missing values). List the 10 races with the highest average first, with any race lacking an average placed last. Only results classified after 12th (13th onward) are included. Results classified exactly 12th are excluded.
c.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS FLOAT)) as avgLaps FROM races r INNER JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avgLaps IS NOT NULL DESC, avgLaps DESC

d.request: For each race, calculate the average number of laps completed (excluding missing values) for results classified 13th or worse (positionOrder > 12), displaying race ID and race name, ordered by highest average laps first with races lacking an average placed last.
d.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM races r LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId AND res.positionOrder > 12 AND res.laps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC
